claim: AWS Backup restores an Aurora cluster; it does not create or attach an Amazon RDS instance to the cluster, and the guide's steps then create and attach an Amazon RDS instance to the restored Aurora cluster using the CLI.

evidence.quote: AWS Backup restores your Aurora cluster; it does not create or attach an Amazon RDS instance to your cluster. In the following steps, you will create and attach an Amazon RDS instance to your restored Aurora cluster using the CLI.
